implementation_detail: 3B dense MLLM2vec backbone; prompt ends with EMB token; MRL dimensions 256/512/1024/2048/3072; about two billion image-text pairs plus anc-pos-neg triplets
main_benefit: Builds concept-level alignment and deployable low-dimensional prefixes
main_risk: Still contrastive and therefore not enough for exact ID discrimination

implementation_detail: Billion-scale purified prototype-ID centroids initialize rows of an ultra-scale linear head
main_benefit: Converts latent space from relative proximity to absolute semantic anchors
main_risk: Requires high-purity prototype clusters; noisy anchors become systematic labels

implementation_detail: End-to-end training of MLLM2vec plus ID head with normalized embeddings and anchors; KNN sparse negatives; dynamic proxy update
main_benefit: Improves intra-ID compactness and inter-ID angular separation
main_risk: Scaling depends on prototype matrix memory, sparse negative quality and update cadence

implementation_detail: Query-document pair prompt; score is probability of Yes or Rel token; BCE/next-token training
main_risk: No comparative context; O(N) forward-pass pattern repeats query processing

implementation_detail: Split candidates into chunks of up to M=10; select best document index or NULL; optimize pairwise ranking and NULL-token losses
main_benefit: Captures within-chunk comparisons and runs chunks in parallel
main_risk: Cross-chunk scores are not directly comparable without calibration

implementation_detail: Reuse chunkwise hidden states; mean-pool query/document image token segments; classify labels 0/1/2/3
main_benefit: Adds chunk-agnostic absolute scale with no extra MLLM forward pass
main_risk: Calibration must remain stable across category, query and chunk distributions

implementation_detail: Preserve local chunk order; repeatedly choose the current head item with the highest absolute score
main_benefit: Combines local comparative order and global calibrated priority
main_risk: Greedy merge can inherit early local ordering mistakes
